The '''Primarin system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the corporation known as the [[Primarin Starshipwrights Union]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Primarin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="TEA" />
